patches.replacement: Read ../AGENTS.md, then select owning context through ../docs/agent-context-routing.md. Do not duplicate architecture, authority or Phase rules here.

patches.operation: short entry point; preserve full original body as reference
patches.reference_content: Original SKILL.md body after frontmatter, unchanged; mark as task-scoped technique reference.
patches.replacement_description: Design a new landing page or portfolio, or an explicitly requested visual redesign. Excludes routine bug fixes and existing-pattern UI edits. Follow repository stack and scope.
entry_rules: Repository authority, architecture and current task override technique defaults.
Declare a design direction only when doing design; infer routine details from repo evidence.
Read reference sections 0/11 for a redesign, 2/4 for visual direction, 3 only for stack integration, 5/6 only for motion, and appendices only for an explicitly selected system.
Keep existing packages/fonts/icons; proposing an install is not approval or an instruction to switch stack.
Run task-required validation, not every visual ritual.

patches.operation: narrow description and add scope block immediately after frontmatter; retain technique body
patches.scope_block: Use only for the specific deliverable named in this skill. Current user scope and repository canonical decisions override every technique, package, font, icon, image-count and output default below. Existing-pattern fixes do not trigger redesign or image generation. Read the repository operating contract for authority; this skill grants no external-write, Production, destructive or merge authority. Reuse valid approvals; ask only for consequential missing choices.

descriptions.brandkit: Generate brand identity boards or logo-system concepts when requested; does not implement application UI.
descriptions.high-end-visual-design: Apply a specifically requested high-end visual redesign; preserve existing stack and asset availability.
descriptions.image-to-code: Implement an explicitly requested image-first design workflow; generate references only within that workflow's approved scope.
descriptions.imagegen-frontend-mobile: Generate mobile app concept images; not application code or routine website edits.
descriptions.imagegen-frontend-web: Generate website design reference images when requested; section-count defaults apply only to that image deliverable.
descriptions.industrial-brutalist-ui: Apply an explicitly selected industrial brutalist visual direction; does not impose it on ordinary UI work.
descriptions.minimalist-ui: Apply an explicitly selected minimalist editorial visual direction; preserve repository UI components and dependencies.
descriptions.redesign-existing-projects: Audit and implement a requested redesign of an existing interface; preserve functionality and task boundaries.
descriptions.stitch-design-taste: Create a requested Google Stitch DESIGN.md artifact; its authority is limited to that design deliverable.

patches.operation: Create and execute offline structural/preservation tests only
patches.spec: Offline structural safety and routing checks derived from benchmark-fixtures.json and README precedence cases. Verify links, authority retention, alias parity and no unconditional history/skill load. No network, DB, mutation or brittle full-text snapshot. Do not equate structural PASS with model behavior validation.
Exact changed-file hashes, structural results, remaining unknowns. Slice 3 independently records actual three-task before/after runs, calls, repeats, clarifications and approval rounds.
